tasks.prompt: Dynamic anime action scene. On the left, the blonde twin-tail demon girl fiercely swings her giant X-shaped battleaxe downward with a powerful motion blur while her black-and-red dress and bat wings flutter violently. On the right, the terrified orange-haired scholar girl flinches backward hugging her leather book tightly as loose white papers scatter and swirl wildly through the sunlit library air. Smooth 2D anime animation, expressive motion.
